speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: The Police do their best to ascertain the ownership of the seized property by examining bank transaction records.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: The seized property may often be needed for continuing investigations or subsequent court proceedings.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: If they are not so needed, the Police would apply to the Court for the property to be returned to the rightful owners.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: This is because seized proceeds could be co-mingled with other non-scam-related activities, such as cases involving unlicensed moneylending proceeds.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: Seized proceeds may also not be directly correlated to crime committed in that same year.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: It would also be resource-intensive, given the high volume of scam cases.

speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
text: In the case of the $3 billion money laundering case that was reported recently, has the Government Gazette been published to invite potential victims to submit their claims, and if not, when would that be?

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: Specifically, on the $3 billion case, as it is specific to that case, could I invite the Member to file a separate Parliamentary Question, because it is quite case-specific?

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: On his other proposal regarding whether or not there could be a consolidated fund of some sorts where victims could perhaps through the fund, be able to recover some of their lost amounts, I would like to say that various proposals are being considered to see how best to be able to compensate victims.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: But what I would like to add is the operational challenges that I had shared earlier in my main reply, which is that often times, the monies that are recovered by the Anti-Scam Centre, through the course of investigations, we are not able to ascertain specifically that all the monies recovered actually all pertain to scams.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: Because often times, the syndicates that run these scams operate a lot of various other crime business lines as well.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: So, the proceeds which are recovered by the Anti-Scam Centre are not just scam proceeds.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: There could be other proceeds that pertain to other forms of crime and therefore, there are other victims who may also similarly feel that they have a claim to those proceeds.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: So, that is the first point I would like to make.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: The second point I would like to make is that it is often very difficult to be able to track whether this dollar that is part of the proceeds and monies recovered actually is that dollar which was lost to one particular victim.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: And that is because of the co-mingling of funds.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: I think people who understand the scam landscape know that this co-mingling and in the cases where cryptocurrency is involved because of the use of cryptocurrency tumblers and mixers, it is often very, very difficult to ascertain for that dollar recovered, from which victim that dollar has actually been scammed from.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: As a result of that, it is thus going to be very difficult for us to be able to say, when you have a consolidated fund, which victim actually has a right to the monies that have been recovered.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: So, there are going to be far more claimants for the monies than there are actually proceeds in the monies that are recovered.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: So, at the end of the day, victims if they ever are to be able to recover some portion of their monies, it is going to be a tiny fraction of what they lost in the first place.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: The very last point I would like to add is that we should also be concerned about how scammers, if they know that we have such a consolidated fund, how they may try to pivot and see how they could potentially entice other types of mules to participate in scam activities and potentially then, try to "recover" the monies from this scam recovery fund.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: So, I am just trying to share with you that there are various, various difficulties and concerns that we have.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: But at the end of the day, principle-wise, I agree with you that we should do our very best to be able to find some way of recovering proceeds and of course, compensating victims.
